,COUNT(DISTINCT if(DATE_FORMAT(n.date_serv,'%m') IN(10,11,12,1,2)  AND nutri3 in(2), CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.PID),NULL)) A7Q1
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(DATE_FORMAT(n.date_serv,'%m') IN(5,6,7,8,9) AND nutri3 in(2), CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.PID),NULL)) A7Q2

,COUNT(DISTINCT if(DATE_FORMAT(n.date_serv,'%m') IN(10,11,12,1,2)  AND nutri3 in(3), CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.PID),NULL)) A8Q1

FROM
t_nutrition_service6_14 n inner join chospital h on n.hospcode=h.hoscode
WHERE h.provcode in(@prov_c)   AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR,n.birth,n.DATE_SERV) BETWEEN 6 AND 14

rows.notice:
*** กำหนดตัดข้อมูลรายงานผล ณ วันที่ 16 ก.พ. (ภาคเรียนที่ 2) ณ วันที่ 16 ส.ค. (ภาคเรียนที่ 1)
ประเมินจากแฟ้ม NUTRITION - เด็กอายุ 6-14 ปี
- เด็ก 1 คน หากมีการชั่งน้ำหนักวัดส่วนสูงเกิน 1 ครั้งต่อเทอม จะยึดค่าน้ำหนักและส่วนสูงครั้งสุดท้ายของเทอม
-เด็ก 1 คน หากมีการชั่งน้ำหนักวัดส่วนสูง ทั้ง 2 เทอมจะนับให้เทอมละ 1 ครั้ง
สรุปตัดความซ้ำซ้อนด้วย HOSPCODE,PID,เทอม
ค่าน้ำหนักต้องอยู่ในช่วง 0.1 ถึง 300 กก.ค่าส่วนสูงต้องอยู่ในช่วง 40 ถึง 250 ซม.สัญชาติ ไทย
นับตามวันที่ให้บริการ(DATE_SERV) ที่อยู่ในช่วง เดือน พค. ถึง สค.(เทอม 1) , เดือน ตค. ถึง กพ.(เทอม 2) เท่านั้น
rows.indiv_sql:
SET @prov_c:=(SELECT provincecode FROM sys_config LIMIT 1);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx  IGNORE AS
SELECT p.check_hosp as hospcode,p.PID,p.CID,p.NAME,p.LNAME,p.SEX,p.BIRTH
,p.HID, p.addr, p.check_vhid,p.NATION,p.DISCHARGE,p.check_typearea
,n.seq,n.date_serv,n.quarter_m,n.weight,n.height,n.nutri1,n.nutri2,n.nutri3
,IF(n.nutri2 in(3,4,5), 'สูงดี',null)  AS result1
,IF(n.nutri3 in(3),'สมส่วน',null) AS result2
,IF(n.nutri2 in(3,4,5) AND nutri3 in(3), 'สูงดีสมส่วน',null)  AS result3
FROM
t_nutrition_service6_14 n inner join chospital h on n.hospcode=h.hoscode
INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON n.hospcode=p.HOSPCODE AND n.pid=p.pid
WHERE h.provcode in(@prov_c)   AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR,n.birth,n.DATE_SERV) BETWEEN 6 AND 14
AND DATE_FORMAT(n.DATE_SERV,'%m') IN(5,6,7,10,11,12,1)
ORDER BY p.hospcode,p.pid,n.quarter_m;

SELECT h.hoscode,h.hosname,s.PID,s.CID,s.NAME,s.LNAME,s.SEX,s.BIRTH
,s.HID, s.addr, s.check_vhid,s.NATION,s.DISCHARGE,s.check_typearea
,s.seq,s.date_serv,s.quarter_m,s.weight,s.height,s.nutri1,s.nutri2,s.nutri3
,s.result1,s.result2,s.result3
FROM
tx s
INNER JOIN chospital h ON s.hospcode = h.hoscode
WHERE  1=1 {where}

zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("targetq1") as "targetq1" ,SUM("targetq2") as "targetq2" ,SUM("resultq1") as "resultq1" ,SUM("resultq2") as "resultq2" ,SUM("a2q1") as "a2q1" ,SUM("a2q2") as "a2q2" ,SUM("a3q1") as "a3q1" ,SUM("a3q2") as "a3q2" ,SUM("a4q1") as "a4q1" ,SUM("a4q2") as "a4q2" ,SUM("b3q1") as "b3q1" ,SUM("b3q2") as "b3q2" ,SUM("a5q1") as "a5q1" ,SUM("a5q2") as "a5q2" ,SUM("b4q1") as "b4q1" ,SUM("b4q2") as "b4q2" ,SUM("a6q1") as "a6q1" ,SUM("a6q2") as "a6q2" ,SUM("a7q1") as "a7q1" ,SUM("a7q2") as "a7q2" ,SUM("a8q1") as "a8q1" ,SUM("a8q2") as "a8q2" ,SUM("a9q1") as "a9q1" ,SUM("a9q2") as "a9q2" ,SUM("a10q1") as "a10q1" ,SUM("a10q2") as "a10q2" ,SUM("a11q1") as "a11q1" ,SUM("a11q2") as "a11q2" ,SUM("a12q1") as "a12q1" ,SUM("a12q2") as "a12q2" ,SUM("a13q1") as "a13q1" ,SUM("a13q2") as "a13q2"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

service_plan.query: SELECT c.splevel as a_code ,c.splevel as a_name , SUM("targetq1") as "targetq1" ,SUM("targetq2") as "targetq2" ,SUM("resultq1") as "resultq1" ,SUM("resultq2") as "resultq2" ,SUM("a2q1") as "a2q1" ,SUM("a2q2") as "a2q2" ,SUM("a3q1") as "a3q1" ,SUM("a3q2") as "a3q2" ,SUM("a4q1") as "a4q1" ,SUM("a4q2") as "a4q2" ,SUM("b3q1") as "b3q1" ,SUM("b3q2") as "b3q2" ,SUM("a5q1") as "a5q1" ,SUM("a5q2") as "a5q2" ,SUM("b4q1") as "b4q1" ,SUM("b4q2") as "b4q2" ,SUM("a6q1") as "a6q1" ,SUM("a6q2") as "a6q2" ,SUM("a7q1") as "a7q1" ,SUM("a7q2") as "a7q2" ,SUM("a8q1") as "a8q1" ,SUM("a8q2") as "a8q2" ,SUM("a9q1") as "a9q1" ,SUM("a9q2") as "a9q2" ,SUM("a10q1") as "a10q1" ,SUM("a10q2") as "a10q2" ,SUM("a11q1") as "a11q1" ,SUM("a11q2") as "a11q2" ,SUM("a12q1") as "a12q1" ,SUM("a12q2") as "a12q2" ,SUM("a13q1") as "a13q1" ,SUM("a13q2") as "a13q2"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp as c ON h.hoscode = c.hcode LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( c.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} ) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY c.splevel

service_plan_hospital.query: SELECT c.hcode as a_code ,CONCAT(c.splevel,':',c.hname) as a_name , SUM("targetq1") as "targetq1" ,SUM("targetq2") as "targetq2" ,SUM("resultq1") as "resultq1" ,SUM("resultq2") as "resultq2" ,SUM("a2q1") as "a2q1" ,SUM("a2q2") as "a2q2" ,SUM("a3q1") as "a3q1" ,SUM("a3q2") as "a3q2" ,SUM("a4q1") as "a4q1" ,SUM("a4q2") as "a4q2" ,SUM("b3q1") as "b3q1" ,SUM("b3q2") as "b3q2" ,SUM("a5q1") as "a5q1" ,SUM("a5q2") as "a5q2" ,SUM("b4q1") as "b4q1" ,SUM("b4q2") as "b4q2" ,SUM("a6q1") as "a6q1" ,SUM("a6q2") as "a6q2" ,SUM("a7q1") as "a7q1" ,SUM("a7q2") as "a7q2" ,SUM("a8q1") as "a8q1" ,SUM("a8q2") as "a8q2" ,SUM("a9q1") as "a9q1" ,SUM("a9q2") as "a9q2" ,SUM("a10q1") as "a10q1" ,SUM("a10q2") as "a10q2" ,SUM("a11q1") as "a11q1" ,SUM("a11q2") as "a11q2" ,SUM("a12q1") as "a12q1" ,SUM("a12q2") as "a12q2" ,SUM("a13q1") as "a13q1" ,SUM("a13q2") as "a13q2"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp as c ON s.hospcode = c.hcode AND c.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (c.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY c.splevel, c.hname, c.hcode
